messages:
Alex (Support): customer reported they were billed for ~4.3k tokens but their local SDK estimator shows ~3.9k. Can someone help repro?
Marta (Client Eng): I saw a similar case yesterday with streaming + function_call — client stops counting at the streaming stop event but server finishes adding tool/system tokens after post-processing.
Jia (Runtime): we recently added a tiny routing 'system' insert for tool routing (internal only). It was not intended to be billable, but looks like our metering pipeline picked it up during aggregation. Investigating.
Alex (Support): repro steps I used: curl to /v1/chat/completions with streaming, function_call return, and a system prompt. Example: ```bash
curl -s -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"model":"redwood-alpha","messages":[{"role":"system","content":"You are a helpful assistant"},{"role":"user","content":"Summarize this..."}],"stream":true,"function_call":"auto"}' \n  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/completions
```
Marta (Client Eng): after streaming stops the SDK token counter reads the bytes it saw. But because function_call handling and backend toolchain append hidden metadata and a small KV prefill, the server-side tally increments after the client has already decided the completion is finished.
Jia (Runtime): logs from the runtime show: `INJECT: system_routing_v0` (length 24) and a post-run metadata blob (~40 tokens) added before final aggregation. That blob should have been flagged non-billable; it wasn't.
Alex (Support): customer asked for a concrete diff. Any quick command to show the server vs client counts?
Marta (Client Eng): run our trace helper: ```python tools/trace_tokens.py --replay <curl-output.ndjson> --show --headers``` it prints `client_count` and `server_count` per turn and highlights injected system messages. Also check response header `x-rw-metering-tokens: <n>` on the final request.
Customer: thanks, sharing the curl output and logs now. Need this for our finance audit.
Support-bot: Ticket #5872 created and linked to thread (assignee: @Jia). :thumbsup:
Jia (Runtime): short-term mitigation: we'll ship SDK 0.9.7 with an estimator tweak that accounts for the post-run tool prefill so client estimates match server closely. Long-term fix: mark internal routing/system ops as non-billable in metering. Patch in review, ETA ~48h. If affected invoice delta >5% we will backfill credits.
Marta (Client Eng): note for repro: also test with non-streaming (stream:false). The delta is smaller there because client sees the final output, but the hidden metadata still contributes.
Alex (Support): sending customer repro steps + trace helper and asking them to run SDK 0.9.7 once available. I'll update ticket when patch lands. :eyes:
Customer: appreciated. Please cc finance when you confirm backfill policy.
Jia (Runtime): will loop in billing ops if we detect a class-wide hit. Posting a short log example below for audit:```
SERVER_METER: total_tokens=4312
CLIENT_EST: total_tokens=3918
DIFF_BREAKDOWN:
  injected_system_routing: 24
  postrun_prefill_metadata: 370
```
Alex (Support): great, thanks. Keeping thread open until billing ops sign off.
